verdict.rationale: Persona documents webhooks that notify your service about events on any Persona resource. They deliver real-time status updates when a user is approved, declined, or requires further review, so outcomes arrive without polling. Event filters and OAuth 2.0 client-credentials authentication of outbound deliveries are also documented. Missing for 10: explicit payload signature verification (e.g. an HMAC signing secret), an enumerated event list covering created and processing states, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, verification lifecycle events arrive as signed webhooks — created, processing, verified, requires-input — so my system reacts to outcomes without polling

citations.quote: Webhooks can notify your service about events that happen on any Persona resource.
